Traverse a list in three different ways.

fruits = ["apple", "orange", "mango"]
for fruit in fruits: # best way
    print(fruit)
for i in range(len(fruits)): # when you need the index
    print(i, fruits[i])
i = 0
while i < len(fruits): # while version
    print(fruits[i])
    i += 1
